recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future changes to MeasureImprovementNotation concept wording should be handled through THO/UTG rather than by restoring a core code-system copy.
issue_request: FHIR-19445 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for CQI and requested improved MeasureImprovementNotation code-system wording: increase means an increased score indicates improvement, and decrease means a decreased score indicates improvement, with definitions referring to score or measurement.
initial_application: Jira cites GH#780fae5356. Commit 780fae535659a83903cb316e7dd428d3fde955a5 explicitly mentioned GF#19445 and changed the historical Measure spreadsheet's MeasureImprovementNotation code rows from the older Increase/Decrease wording to the accepted increase/decrease displays and definitions. The same commit also implemented tightly related FHIR-19446 datatype and terminology changes.
additional_context: Measure, MeasureReport, and CodeSystem are active resource types, but the old local core measure-improvement-notation CodeSystem file was later removed as a THO duplicate. FHIR-39623 confirmed measure-improvement-notation and related Measure code systems should be removed from base FHIR and referenced through THO. Current Measure and MeasureReport XML bind improvementNotation to http://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/measure-improvement-notation, while THO CodeSystem version 1.0.1 contains the corrected increase/decrease displays and definitions. An inactive legacy ResearchDefinition spreadsheet still has old wording, but ResearchDefinition is not in the active fhir.ini resource list and was removed from the current build.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because active core source already references the authoritative THO terminology that reflects FHIR-19445, and editing inactive legacy source would not affect the current specification.

related_jiras.note: The same 780fae5356 commit changed improvementNotation datatypes/bindings and terminology direction; it is already represented on the combined branch by commit 0637ec58dae17c064b8b1562dd30dc7422555592.
Later Applied issue moved measure-improvement-notation and related Measure code systems out of base FHIR and confirmed THO as the source.
Later Applied issue relaxed Measure and MeasureReport improvementNotation bindings to extensible, confirming the current binding strength should not be reverted during this audit.
